# stripe_metronome_customer (Resource)

A Metronome customer and its usage ingest aliases. Customer archival can archive contracts and void invoices; deletion protection is enabled by default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Set false and apply before destroying. Archiving a customer can affect invoices and every contract, including unmanaged ones.
- `ingest_aliases` (Set of String) Aliases used as customer_id in usage events. Setting this replaces the full alias set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
